chunks.text: Today we will talk about Costa Rica.
Costa Rica is a green, peaceful, and happy country in Central America.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Costa Rica?
Costa Rica is in Central America.
It is between Nicaragua and Panama.
To the west is the Pacific Ocean and to the east is the Caribbean Sea.
Costa Rica has beaches, mountains, rainforests, and volcanoes.
What is the capital city of Costa Rica?
The capital city is San Jose.
It is in the center of the country.
San Jose has museums, parks, markets, and busy streets.
Other important cities are Alahuela, Cartaga, Heredia, Liberia, near the beach.
How many people live in Costa Rica?
About five million people live in Costa Rica.
Most people live in cities and towns in the middle of the country.
The people are called Costa Ricans or Ticos for short.
They are known for being friendly, relaxed, and kind.
What language do people speak in Costa Rica?
The official language is Spanish.
Many people also speak some English, especially in tourist areas.
On the Caribbean coast, some people speak Creole English.
What is the weather like in Costa Rica?
Costa Rica has a tropical climate.
There are two seasons, dry season from December to April, rainy season from May to November.
It is warm all year.
The beaches are hot and the mountains are cool.
What does Costa Rica look like?
Costa Rica has rainforests with tall trees and animals, beaches with white or black sand, volcanoes like Arenal and Poas Mountains, rivers and waterfalls.
It is one of the most eco -friendly countries in the world.
What animals live in Costa Rica?
Costa Rica has many animals like monkeys, sloths and jaguars, frogs, snakes and lizards, birds like toucans, hummingbirds and macaws, butterflies, bats and insects.
In the ocean, you can find dolphins, whales, and sea turtles.
What do people eat in Costa Rica?
Costa Rican food is simple, fresh and tasty.

People eat rice, beans and plantains, chicken, beef and fish, fruits like mango, papaya, pineapple and banana, popular dishes, galopinto, rice and beans for breakfast, cassado, a lunch plate with rice, beans, meat, salad and plantains, sopa negra, black bean soup, tamales, corn dough with meat wrapped in banana leaves.
What do people drink in Costa Rica?
People drink coffee.
Costa Rica grows very good coffee, fresh fruit juice, water and herbal tea.
Adults may drink beer or aguardiente, a local spirit.
Coffee is often served with breakfast or in the afternoon.
What is life like in Costa Rica?
Life in Costa Rica is calm, happy and family centered.
People enjoy spending time with family, walking in nature, going to the beach, drinking coffee and talking with friends, watching football soccer.
A favorite sport, Costa Ricans love the phrase pura vita, which means pure life.
It means everything is good, life is simple and be happy.
What are some holidays and traditions in Costa Rica?
Independence Day, September 15, Christmas with lights, music and tamales.
Easter week, Samana Santa, a quiet time for family and church.
Juan Santa Maria Day, April 11 for a national hero.
Annexation of Guanacaste, July 25.
People celebrate with parades, folk dances, music and traditional dress.
Some fun facts about Costa Rica.
Costa Rica has no army.
It ended in 1949.
About 25 % of the land is protected nature.
It is one of the happiest countries in the world.
Many people live to be over 100 years old.
The flag is blue, white and red.
Now you know many things about Costa Rica.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about the nature, animals and culture.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
